title: Enterprise Connectivity: corrected monthly transfer assessment handling
content:
## Situation and capability
Enterprise Connectivity: When the corresponding accounting action is due, this entry governs corrected monthly transfer assessment. The accountant completes the selected network billing review, recording its corrected net subtotal and an approved incorrect decision. The returned review receipt makes the completed assessment observable.

## Invocation
assess_network_f148f79a is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.

## Parameter network_holding_id
Corrected monthly transfer assessment uses `network_holding_id`: Id class — Network contract identifier copied from find_network_holdings.

## Parameter network_event_id
Corrected monthly transfer assessment uses `network_event_id`: Id class — Evidence event identifier copied from find_network_events.

## Parameter source_event_id
Corrected monthly transfer assessment uses `source_event_id`: Id class — Exact original charge or payment identifier copied from find_network_events.

## Parameter related_event_id
Corrected monthly transfer assessment uses `related_event_id`: Id class — Review identifier copied from find_network_events.

## Parameter net_amount
Corrected monthly transfer assessment uses `net_amount`: Fixed-format class — Corrected pretax subtotal in unit USD to two decimals, decimal number to two decimals; supplied after final half-up rounding, stored at two-decimal precision.

## Successful receipt
A dictionary containing event_id (string business-event reference) and net_amount (USD decimal number to two decimals); receipt presence confirms the accounting action completed.
